what: LIVE proof that the fire-93 _speaker fix works — measured on real rooms the beat produced, not by replay.
method: Split every room with a transcript by whether its newest message predates or postdates the fix landing on main (2026-08-01T21:00Z), then asked whether a checker or improver actually spoke.
reading: 19% -> 64%. The earlier evidence was a deterministic replay predicting 79 of 92 rooms would gain a checker turn; this is the live confirmation. Not 100% because some departments still run 3-turn rooms where only doer+checker+lead fit, and a few rooms close before the checker's turn.
caveat: This measures whether a challenge HAPPENED, not whether it was any good. Challenge QUALITY is still unmeasured and remains the open gap.
